greeting: Welcome to MoveWell Physiotherapy. I can help you with appointment bookings, therapy services, opening hours, and common enquiries. How may I assist you today?

booking_flow.lead_prompt: Certainly. I can help you reserve a therapy session. May I know your full name?

faqs.a: We offer posture assessment, sports injury rehabilitation, neck and back therapy, joint mobility sessions, and recovery consultations.
We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
Please give at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or reschedule your session.

cancellation_policy: Please give at least 24 hours' notice before your physiotherapy session if you need to cancel or reschedule.
pricing: Pricing depends on the therapy service and session length. A specialist can confirm the recommended package during booking.
fallback: I can help with appointment enquiries, therapy services, pricing, and treatment questions. What would you like to know?
